review: Wuthering Heights Butler Faust is a Sinking Support ID with great Sinking application and passable clashes. In a Sinking Team, where she should be used generally, her clashes go up to 11/17/20 which is good clashes for a 00 ID. On top of that, Faust is not only Sinking Count positive on most of her skills, but also her Sinking Potency application is pretty good thanks to her easy to access passive. Wuthering Heights Butler Faust can also inflict Echoes of the Manor on her S3 but Manor is rather lackluster effect and should be treated as a bonus, rather than something to be relied on. For a Sinking Team, Wuthering Heights Butler Faust is an all around great ID for stacking Sinking Count on an enemy, helping the team maintain a high Sinking Potency. Notable E.G.O.
